‘Serangan Balik' (Never Surrender) Teaser Sees a Grandpa Turn Into an Action Hero for His Family, Premiering November 12


Netflix has announced that its latest Indonesian film,


Never Surrender


, directed by


Sidharta Tata


, will premiere on


November 12


. More than just an action film,


Never Surrender


tells the story of an unlikely hero who fights to reunite his family. The teaser trailer offers a glimpse into the chain of events that forces a grandfather to draw on his combat skills to protect his family from the threat of a criminal syndicate. Set in a small village in Central Java, a grandfather accustomed to living alone must care for his two grandchildren, whom he has not seen in a long time. However, a major problem from Jakarta follows them — and a group of ruthless criminals storms their home, trapping them in a life-threatening situation. To survive, the grandfather and his grandchildren have only two choices: surrender or fight back.


This action film balances high-stakes combat with a heartfelt story about family, highlighting the emotional journey of three generations as they rebuild trust amid grief and atoning for the past. Combining intense fight sequences, tactical ingenuity and family dynamics that feel grounded in real life,


Never Surrender


marks Sidharta Tata’s first collaboration with renowned producers


Kimo Stamboel


and


Edwin Nazir


.


Starring


Lukman Sardi


,


Callista Arum


,


Sulthan Hamonangan


,


Derby Romero


and


Donny Alamsyah


,


Never Surrender


premieres November 12, only on Netflix.
